Description:
COMPLETE, verified against real reported-failing text, committed and baselined 2026-08-11 (commit 0518a78, tag baseline_chip_relevance_inspection_boundary).

FIXED:
1. intentparser.js extractEntities() treated any single capitalized word as a proper-noun entity (PROTECT, TIME HORIZON, KIDS...). Fixed: quoted phrases or 2+ consecutive Title-Case words required; a lone capitalized common noun never matches.
2. Real PDF/document-paste artifacts collapse whitespace between adjacent field labels, producing garbled compound chips (PROFILERISK, SNAPSHOTAGE). Fixed via splitCollapsedCompounds() -- inserts a space at internal lowercase-to-uppercase transitions before entity matching -- paired with a KNOWN_CAMELCASE_BRANDS whitelist (PayPal, YouTube, LinkedIn, etc.) so real brand names are not wrongly split.
3. analysisidlefield.jsx TRENDING chips now require typed text (no chips from an empty box or domain selection alone); literal token/stem matching only against DOMAIN_PRECURSORS + live signals; zero-score candidates dropped, never padded with filler.
4. conemap.jsx InspectionPanel had zero lens/page gating, was rendering on every left-nav page (History/Community/News/etc). Gated to surfaceVisible && (viewportLens === NAV_SURFACE || viewportLens === OBSERVE) -- Hero+Surface+Observe only. Confirmed live.

BUILT THEN REJECTED: CARL (Concept Alias Retrieval Layer), a governed alias-based concept-retrieval system (domainconcepts.js, carl.js). Fully designed, built, live-tested, then explicitly rejected by Founder same session. Cleanly reverted -- see specs/SPEC-carl-concept-alias-retrieval-layer.md, status REJECTED, kept as design record.

REJECTED APPROACHES (do not repeat): broadening DOMAIN_PRECURSORS content to force chip matches (Founder: wide search net = weak target packet -- zero chips for an out-of-vocabulary query is correct output, not a defect); treating the garbled-compound bug as an internal pipeline boundary-loss issue (false lead -- whitespace was lost in the raw pasted source text before it ever reached the app, no pipeline stage exists to trace); docs/mifid-your-investor-profile.pdf as the source of the garbled text (refuted by reading all 16 pages).

OPEN, UNRESOLVED: FINANCIAL domain's 8-term DOMAIN_PRECURSORS vocabulary (AGENTIC AI, AI ACCOUNTABILITY, AFFORDABILITY PRESSURE, LOUD BUDGETING, YIELD HUNTING, STABLECOIN ADOPTION, PRIVATE CREDIT, CYBERSECURITY) does not cover common real-world FINANCIAL queries and its relevance was directly challenged by the Founder at session end -- needs Founder-led reconsideration, not agent-side patching.
